info.title: Deepdub API
info.description: Deepdub's Text-to-Speech API enables high-quality, expressive speech generation with voice cloning, accent control, and real-time streaming capabilities.

post.description: Generate and stream TTS audio based on the provided text. Returns an audio stream in the specified format (default MP3). Supported formats: `mp3`, `opus`, `mulaw`. For `wav` or `s16le` output, use the WebSocket API.

200.description: Audio stream in the requested format (MP3, Opus, or mulaw depending on `format` parameter). The response body is raw audio bytes.

400.description: Bad request — invalid or missing parameters

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

example.message: Unauthorized: invalid or missing API key

402.description: Insufficient credits — your account has run out of TTS credits

example.message: InsufficientCredits: your account has no remaining credits

429.description: Rate limit exceeded — too many concurrent requests

post.description: Submit a TTS generation request for asynchronous processing. Returns a URL that can be polled later to retrieve the generated audio. Useful for long-form generations or workflows that don't need streaming. The request body is the same as `POST /tts`.
post.summary: Submit a retroactive TTS generation request

200.description: Generation accepted. Returns a URL to fetch the generated audio when ready.

400.description: Bad request — invalid or missing parameters

401.description: Unauthorized — invalid or missing API key

example.message: Unauthorized: invalid or missing API key

get.description: Stream the generated audio for a previously submitted retroactive TTS request. Use the `id` from the URL returned by `POST /tts/retroactive`. The response is raw audio bytes (MP3).
get.summary: Get audio for a retroactive TTS request

parameters.description: Generation ID returned by the retroactive TTS submission. File extensions like `.mp3` are stripped automatically.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: API key for authentication. Must start with `dd-` prefix.

model.AccentControl.description: Parameters for fine-tuning accent characteristics in generated speech

accentBaseLocale.description: Base locale for the accent (e.g., en-US, fr-FR)

accentLocale.description: Target accent locale to blend with (e.g., en-GB, es-ES)

accentRatio.description: Ratio of accent blending from 0.0 to 1.0 (0.0 = base locale only, 1.0 = target locale only)

model.GenerationRequest.description:
Request structure for TTS generation endpoints.

**Optional parameters** (not shown in playground): `generationId` (string), `targetDuration` (number, seconds), `tempo` (number, 0.5–2.0), `variance` (number, 0.0–1.0), `seed` (integer), `temperature` (number, 0.0–1.0), `sampleRate` (integer), `format` (string: mp3/opus/mulaw — default mp3), `promptBoost` (boolean), `superStretch` (boolean), `realtime` (boolean), `cleanAudio` (boolean, default true), `autoGain` (boolean), `publish` (boolean), `accentControl` (object with accentBaseLocale, accentLocale, accentRatio), `performanceReferencePromptId` (string), `voiceReference` (string, base64-encoded audio).

model.description: Model ID to use for generation

targetText.description: Text to be converted to speech

voicePromptId.description: ID of the voice prompt to use for generation

model.URLResponse.description: Response containing a URL where the asynchronously generated TTS audio can be retrieved

url.description: URL to fetch the generated audio (issue a GET request with the same `x-api-key` header).

model.GenderClassificationRequest.description: Request for gender classification from audio

audio_url.description: URL to an audio file (S3 or HTTP). Provide either audio_url or audio_base64.

audio_base64.description: Base64-encoded audio data. Provide either audio_url or audio_base64.

prediction.description: Full prediction scores for both genders

duration_seconds.description: Duration of the audio in seconds

detail.example: Either audio_url or audio_base64 must be provided

model.APIError.description: Error response returned for all non-2xx status codes

model.VoicePrompt.description: A voice prompt representing a cloned or uploaded voice

id.description: Unique identifier for the voice prompt

name.description: Display name of the voice prompt

text.description: Transcript text associated with the voice prompt

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the voice prompt was created

model.VoiceBankAPIRequest.description: Request to upload a voice sample and create a voice prompt

filename.description: Name of the audio file being uploaded

text.description: Transcript of the spoken text in the audio sample
text.example: This is a sample recording for voice cloning.

locale.description: Language locale code of the voice sample

publish.description: Whether to make the voice prompt publicly available

model.VoiceBankAPIResponse.description: Response after creating or deleting a voice prompt

voice_prompt_id.description: Unique identifier of the created/affected voice prompt

model.VoiceBankAPIUpdateRequest.description: Request to update a voice prompt's metadata

id.description: Unique identifier for the voice prompt to update

name.description: New display name for the voice prompt

desired_concurrent_connections.description: Desired number of connections in the autoscaling group

model.UpdateASGRequest.description: Request to update autoscaling group capacity

size.description: Desired capacity for the autoscaling group

model.CreateIssueRequest.description: Payload for creating a new issue against a TTS generation

generationId.description: ID of the generation that has the problem

generatedText.description: Text that was passed to the TTS endpoint

problemWord.description: Word (or phrase) that was generated incorrectly

voicePromptId.description: ID of the voice prompt used in the generation

problemAudioFile.description: Optional base64-encoded audio clip to attach to the issue

problemSeconds.description: Seconds in the audio where the problem appears

model.UpdateIssueRequest.description: Payload for updating an existing issue. All fields are optional.

problemAudioFile.description: Optional base64-encoded audio clip to attach to the issue

state.description: Current state of the issue (e.g., open, in progress, resolved)

model.IssueErrorResponse.description: Error response from the issues endpoints
